# CAM QBO baseline

`qbo.F90` is the archived baseline from CAM `cam_cesm2_1_rel_60`, originally at `src/physics/waccm/qbo.F90`. It is used by the source-preparation regression tests.

SHA-256: `7e098beb9455d7c45a6a63ffc2f457d29a3d9e971cf9f1643b748a59a0212a64`.

The file is unchanged. Its author information is retained in the source, and `LICENSE.txt` contains the CESM2 copyright and terms distributed with the parent source tree. `.gitattributes` preserves the Fortran files' original line endings because preparation checks their byte hashes.
